'''Mitar''' was the [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Daimar]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the leader of the [[Lamont Dynasty of Daimar]]. His children were [[Erra]], [[Rondar]], and [[Torrin]] and his granddaughter was [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Winera]].

==Biography==
After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had blockaded Daimar, Mitar sent some of Daimar's most important figures, including [[Alet Komain]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shen-Ji Collun]], and his own granddaughter, Princess Winera, to the planet [[Byrsym]] to meet with Mitar's son, Torrin. Torrin was leading an anti-Imperial resistance group, and was pleased to safely receive the group, and protect them on Byrsysm so that they would not fall into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] hands. Mitar, however, stayed in Daimar with his son Rondar.
